eyebrow: Kai Xiao · CRM, ERP & applied AI
headline: I make complex work feel clearer, more useful, and more human.
lede: I work between business strategy, enterprise systems, and emerging AI — helping organizations modernize the way people sell, serve, operate, and make decisions.
aboutTitle: A systems person who still starts with people.
aboutParagraphs: I started from business and systems analysis, and over time moved deeper into CRM, customer service, sales process design, Dynamics 365, and Power Platform. What I enjoy most is helping people describe what they need clearly enough that a solution can be designed, built, tested, and adopted.

My background includes CRM modernization, public-sector cloud migration, enterprise-wide Dynamics 365 rollouts, lead scoring automation, and BI-enabled operations. I am now especially interested in how Copilot, agents, and applied AI can become useful inside real business processes rather than remain isolated technology experiments.
personalNoteTitle: Not just systems. Also people, habits, and adoption.
personalNote: The most successful CRM projects I have seen were not only about choosing the right platform. They worked because users understood the purpose, managers trusted the data, and the new process made daily work easier instead of heavier.
quote: I see CRM as a shared operating system for customer-facing teams. If the workflow is unclear, AI will only make the confusion faster. If the workflow is clear, AI can become genuinely useful.
